components.maturity: High for data shape; signal validity varies by signal and schema.
components.name: Canonical telemetry schema
components.responsibility: Defines the signal contract and verified/provisional signal metadata used by downstream features.

components.maturity: High for deterministic feature computation; not sufficient for waveform-level causal inference.
components.name: Window feature engineering
components.responsibility: Computes fixed per-window statistical and relationship features used by detectors.

components.maturity: Engineering-validated; it does not train, vote, fuse scores, or choose root causes.
components.name: Model Harness
components.responsibility: Runs enabled detectors independently and preserves ok/skipped/failed states.

components.maturity: Parity-validated against pre-H1 handoff; empirical evidence is controlled and sparse.
components.name: Isolation Forest detector
components.responsibility: Production compatibility baseline for multivariate anomaly detection.

components.maturity: Stable under H3.1 reference review, but not production-gating and not a fault detector.
components.name: Contextual Battery detector
components.responsibility: Research detector for battery-voltage deviations within explicit RPM/TPS operating contexts.

components.maturity: Stable one-event behavior, but no unique event-level value beyond active detectors.
components.name: Temporal Battery Shift detector
components.responsibility: Offline candidate for sustained battery-voltage changes.

components.maturity: Feasible but low-coverage, parameter-sensitive, and not justified as Core 3.
components.name: Temporal RPM Stability detector
components.responsibility: Offline candidate for sustained RPM variability increases during closed-throttle running.

components.maturity: Useful for coverage/disagreement semantics; not a production decision-maker.
components.name: Evidence Aggregator
components.responsibility: Preserves heterogeneous detector findings without fusion or consensus diagnosis.

components.maturity: Preserved for reproducibility; causal language was not supported by evidence.
components.name: RCA v1

components.maturity: Research-worthy diagnostic interpretation; current possible-cause output count is zero.
components.name: RCA v2
components.responsibility: Evidence-grounded interpretation engine that avoids unsupported causal claims.

components.maturity: Adds prioritization and recurrence context; does not create causes.
components.name: Historical Evidence
components.responsibility: Offline cross-session evidence layer with leakage prevention and provenance.

components.maturity: Analyzer-side contract is additive and DriveSafe consumes it without changing production anomaly semantics.
components.name: Diagnostic Evidence Contract
components.responsibility: Backward-compatible analyzer-side packaging for DriveSafe-style consumers.

components.location: DriveSafe Web App: services/analysis_submission.py, services/pi_sync.py, services/analysis.py, templates/session_detail.html
components.maturity: Engineering integration is complete; it is not scientific validation of detector accuracy, RCA causes or historical maturity.
components.name: DriveSafe Diagnostic Evidence Consumer
components.responsibility: Ingests, persists, serializes and renders research evidence while preserving existing status/health behavior.
